content.query: AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AppRoleName == "docchat-api" and Name != "GET /healthz" | summarize total = sum(ItemCount), failed = sumif(ItemCount, toint(ResultCode) >= 500) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m) | extend availabilityPct = round(100.0 * (total - failed) / total, 3) | project TimeGenerated, availabilityPct
content.title: Availability %

content.query: AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AppRoleName == "docchat-api" and toint(ResultCode) >= 500 | summarize failures = sum(ItemCount) by Name, ResultCode | order by failures desc
content.title: 5xx by operation and code

content.query: AzureMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and ResourceId =~ "{apiSiteId}" and MetricName == "HealthCheckStatus" | summarize healthyPct = avg(Average) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Healthy-instance percentage

content.query: AzureMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and ResourceId =~ "{apiSiteId}" and MetricName in ("Requests", "Http5xx") | summarize value = sum(Total) by MetricName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Platform requests and front-end 5xx

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.api.problems" | summarize problems = sum(Sum) by code = tostring(Properties["code"]), status = tostring(Properties["status"]) | order by problems desc
content.title: Problems by code

content.query: AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AppRoleName == "docchat-api" and Name !in ("POST /v1/chat/turns", "GET /healthz") | summarize p50 = percentile(DurationMs, 50), p95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95), requests = sum(ItemCount) by Name | order by requests desc
content.title: Latency by operation, streams excluded

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("docchat.citation.requests", "docchat.citation.download_aborts", "docchat.chat.disconnects", "docchat.chat.drained_turns") | summarize n = sum(Sum) by Name, detail = coalesce(tostring(Properties["outcome"]), tostring(Properties["reason"]), tostring(Properties["phase"]))
content.title: Citation outcomes, download aborts, stream disconnects and drained turns
